top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a single original idea, the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock, proposed and first demonstrated by Katori and taken to the 10^-18 accuracy and stability frontier by Ye. The result is mature, independently reproduced in several national laboratories and used in fundamental-physics tests and relativistic geodesy, and the two-name allocation is compact and defensible. P002 is a strong, well-attributed theory-plus-experiment case, but the field is young, the pairing mechanism is open and early experimental credit falls outside three names. Either is preferable to no award.
